bodySections.method: OSM base fixed; photographed smooth outline sampled at broad height fractions of reported 310m. Factors are coarse proportional visual estimates, not photogrammetry.
bodySections.uncertainty: height breakpoints ±15m, width/depth factors ±0.08; independent back-side facade pending

crownDropM.method: outer/inner sloped rim difference visually proportioned from full frontal photo using 310m total; no exact crown survey
crownDropM.uncertainty: ±10m; exact roof/helipad level and underside unknown

curtainDepthM.method: bounded by mapped middle feature front-axis extent 45.037m and reviewed saddle photograph; rectangular candidate support depth

curtainCrossCamberM.method: SOM bridge section image 689 and actual oblique photo 698 show convex cross-direction roof; representative rise selected relative to 60m reported span
curtainCrossCamberM.uncertainty: ±5m; engineering catenary/rationalised panel coordinates not obtained

curtainPanelThicknessM.method: thin closed volume represents reviewed panel and makes both sides visible with existing material culling; no measured construction thickness
curtainPanelThicknessM.uncertainty: rendering allowance, physical panel/frame thickness unknown

archUndersideRiseM.method: frontal arch void fitted below reported banquet floor at22m, leaving central passage and side abutments

facadeHorizontalBandM.method: thin repeated structural/floor rhythm observed in official photos; thickness is game-visible representation

facadeVerticalRibM.method: reviewed narrow mullion rhythm; width chosen for low-poly candidate, not measured

facadePerimeterDivisions.method: approx2m bay spacing from196m mapped tower perimeter and photograph rhythm; actual mullion count not claimed

bridgeGlazingInsetM.method: avoid coplanar surfaces in candidate; exact rebate not obtained
